The Windsor sofa is an Arketipo sofa with diamond-quilted upholstery, the button sunk into the padding. The high-end tufting gives the seat a soft, deep feel. Made in Italy.

fichas.descripcion_original: The Windsor Italian luxury designer sofa fits in with all kinds of furnitures: perfect in a Traditional setting, in a Contemporary setting it stands out like a valuable work of art. This Italian sofa with high-end tufted upholstery, has a decidedly distinctive feel. It is refined, luxurious and sophisticated, yet also soft and welcoming, due to the characteristic button buried in the diamond quilting of the padding. Windsor sofa has extended its range with an additional, extra-large sofa of 123″5/8. Besides, there is a new high-end version in velvet which gives the sofa a silky and sumptuous look.Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Soul Rounded Headboard Bed by Turri
fichas.descripcion:
The Soul is a Turri bed with a rounded headboard that curves slightly around the mattress, so frame and headboard read as one continuous body. Wooden details run along both. Made in Italy.

QUEEN OR KING

Both sizes are 96 7/8" deep and 41 3/8" high; only the width changes, 70 1/2" or 86 1/4". Measure the wall before you pick this Italian bed.

COVER OPTIONS

  • Fabric, Cat. X, B, T and F.
  • Leather, Cat. LD, LH, LM and LT.

The cover you choose sets the look, while the wooden frame and headboard details stay the same. See all double beds.
fichas.descripcion_original: The exclusive Soul Bed immediately refers to a feeling of relaxation and well-being. The rounded and accommodating headboard, slightly curved around the mattress, follows the pattern of the seams, giving further softness to the shapes and wooden details that incorporate the bed frame and the headboard. Everything appears as a single and sinuous body. Soul bed is available in different finishes as per collection. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: El H1 identifica el producto por su rasgo distintivo (cabecero redondeado) y la marca. La descripción respeta los datos: medidas y diferencias Queen/King correctas, las tres familias de tapizado con sus categorías bien contadas, el 'Made in Italy' respaldado por la ficha y el cuerpo continuo formado por estructura y cabecero con detalles de madera tal como dice el original. Las keywords 'turri bed' e 'italian bed' aparecen de forma natural, sin frases inventadas ni contradicciones.

fichas.h1: Efesto Murano Candle Holder by Wave Murano Glass
fichas.h1_regla: sin tipo de producto: nombre + marca
fichas.descripcion:
Efesto is a Venetian candle holder hand-blown in Murano glass by Wave Murano Glass. Venetian artisans shape each piece by mouth, so no two come out the same. Made in Italy.

SUN-BLEACHED COLORS

Delicate tones with a soft, sun-bleached effect run through the glass. Small differences in shade and silhouette belong to the hand-blown process.

ONE OR A GROUP

Efesto is a collection, so several holders can sit together on a dining table or a console. Choose two or three and vary the colors. See more Murano glass candle holders.
fichas.descripcion_original: Efesto is an elegant collection of Murano glass candle holders distinguished by their delicate colors and soft sun-bleached effect. Masterfully hand-blown by Venetian artisans, each piece is unique and displays a perfect balance between contemporary elegance and timeless craftsmanship. With their refined silhouettes and versatile design, these candle holders perfectly complement modern and classic interiors, bringing a touch of luminous sophistication to any space. Made in Italy.

omitidas.motivo: La ficha describe un candelero (candle holder), no velas; usar 'Murano candles' afirmaría que el producto son velas de Murano y contradice el dato.

validacion.razon: La descripción se ciñe a la ficha: colección, colores delicados con efecto sun-bleached, soplado a mano por artesanos venecianos, piezas únicas y Made in Italy. No hay materiales, acabados, certificaciones ni cantidades inventadas; la keyword 'venetian candle holder' está integrada con sentido y el conjunto se lee natural, sin relleno de catálogo.

fichas.descripcion:
The Wellness Therapy is a lounger in fabric by Varaschin: a customizable spa bed on stones, feet or a plexiglass support. Made in Italy.

LIGHT, SOUND AND SCENT

A luminous ring ties light, color, sound and scent together in this therapy lounge chair. The Corian touch top adds chromotherapy, aromatherapy, a cup warmer and music.

BASE AND UPHOLSTERY

Only the stones version takes the Corian top. Choose the chaise lounge as a single or a double bed; the lounge chair upholstery comes in Composition 9, Composition 10, fabric C or nine Abaco colors. See all wellness beds and loungers.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Inspired on the search of the best possible to create a balance between body, mind and soul, here is a sophisticated Italian customizable collection for wellness therapy and SPA that consists of a bed (single or double) resting on stones, feet or plexiglass support and a luminous ring. Stones available with Corian touch top with chromotherapy and aromatherapy function, music and cup warmer.

Wellness Therapy is an innovative furnishing system where light, color, sound and scent chase each other, creating an experience of relaxation that is not only form and ergonomics, but in which emotion and holistic sensoriality also come into play. Designed by Varaschin. Made in Italy.

See the “Data Sheet” PDF for technical information.
